findings.title: Scope of Work Defined
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the scope of work and deliverables under the agreement, detailing the services and products to be provided by the Vendor.
evidence_excerpts: The scope of this Agreement extends to a diverse and technologically advanced range of embedded hardware devices engineered for secure financial operations. The Vendor shall supply biometric authentication terminals, smart KYC devices, HSM interfacing modules, payment gateway controller boards, encrypted microcontroller units, secure IoT gateways, transaction authorization devices, branch automation equipment, and any other categories of hardware mutually agreed upon.

findings.title: Acceptance Criteria for Deliverables
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies that the Vendor shall ensure the delivery of devices that meet or exceed the quality and performance specifications captured in the relevant Statements of Work or annexures, which serves as the acceptance criteria for deliverables under this agreement.
evidence_excerpts: the delivery of devices that meet or exceed the quality and performance specifications captured in the relevant Statements of Work or annexures.

findings.title: Service Level Commitments and Performance Expectations
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly outlines the service level commitments made by the Vendor, including response times for device replacements and repairs, as well as operational availability standards.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall deliver all managed services in accordance with well-defined service level commitments that reflect the critical nature of financial operations. The Vendor shall ensure that DOA devices are replaced within a period not exceeding forty-eight hours from the time of formal acknowledgement.

findings.title: Service Credits for SLA Breaches
findings.rationale: The contract specifies that the parties may mutually agree on service credits or compensatory remedies in case of repeated or significant SLA deviations, indicating a clear remedy for missed service level targets.
evidence_excerpts: The Parties may mutually agree on service credits or compensatory remedies in case of repeated or significant SLA deviations.

findings.title: Client-Side Obligations for Vendor Performance
findings.rationale: The Client is responsible for providing timely access to installation sites, ensuring electrical and network readiness, and guaranteeing safe and authorized access for Vendor personnel and service representatives, which are critical for the Vendor's performance.
evidence_excerpts: The Client shall provide timely access to installation sites, ensure electrical and network readiness, and guarantee safe and authorized access for Vendor personnel and service representatives.

findings.title: Service Performance Reporting Mechanism
findings.rationale: The evidence outlines the structured approach to performance reporting, including specific metrics and documentation that will be provided to the Client.
evidence_excerpts: Routine reporting shall include weekly operational reports, incident summaries, device uptime dashboards, RMA cycle logs, inventory status updates, performance efficiency analyses, and monthly service compliance metrics.

findings.title: Liability Cap and Limitations
findings.rationale: The contract specifies limitations on liability, particularly regarding indirect or consequential damages.
evidence_excerpts: Except where arising from gross negligence or intentional misconduct, neither Party shall be liable for indirect or consequential damages such as lost revenue, business interruption, or reputational losses.

findings.title: Indemnification Obligations
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly outlines the indemnification obligations of both parties under the agreement, specifying the circumstances under which each party must indemnify the other.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall indemnify the Client against third-party claims, damages, or liabilities arising directly from manufacturing defects, faulty workmanship, or negligent acts attributable to the Vendor. The Client shall indemnify the Vendor against claims resulting from misuse of equipment, unauthorized modification of firmware or circuitry, breach of operational guidelines, or negligence by Client personnel.

findings.title: Termination for Cause Conditions
findings.rationale: The evidence specifies conditions under which the agreement can be terminated for cause, including fraud, regulatory non-compliance, severe SLA breaches, or security violations.
evidence_excerpts: In cases involving fraud, regulatory non-compliance, severe SLA breaches, or security violations, termination may be executed with immediate effect.

findings.title: Termination for Convenience Notice Period
findings.rationale: The contract specifies the notice period required for termination without cause.
evidence_excerpts: Either Party may terminate this Agreement by providing ninety days’ prior written notice.

findings.title: Confidentiality Obligations Survival Period
findings.rationale: The contract explicitly states the duration for which confidentiality obligations remain in effect after termination.
evidence_excerpts: These obligations shall remain in effect for five years following termination of this Agreement.

findings.title: Intellectual Property Ownership
findings.rationale: The evidence clearly states the ownership of intellectual property created under this agreement, specifying that the Vendor retains ownership of all related intellectual property.
evidence_excerpts: The Vendor shall retain full ownership of all intellectual property relating to device firmware, hardware design, embedded software, diagnostic tools, test scripts, SDKs, schematics, PCB designs, and proprietary algorithms associated with the supplied hardware.

findings.title: Governing Law and Dispute Resolution
findings.rationale: The evidence explicitly states the governing law and the method for resolving disputes, which is arbitration.
evidence_excerpts: This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the jurisdiction specified in the relevant SOW or annexure. Any disputes arising out of or related to this Agreement shall be subjected to arbitration before a panel of arbitrators in accordance with governing arbitration procedures.
